summary: Every acceptance criterion has merged, signed-off work behind it: V07 by P1 (D7 amended); V06 and V08 by P2 (controller metrics Service plus SyncError conditions, additionalUrls https://argocd, render-gate assertions); V01-V05 by P3 (ArgoCDSyncStillFailed, ArgoCDHealthStillDegraded, ArgoCDAlertsBlind, no-resolve receivers, promtool edge tests and alert-routing.py); V10-V11 by P4 (record-only path, hand-run against a scratch repo); V12-V13 by P5 (clean-lucene.sh run by the init container and by the busybox test); V09 is a no-change ruling (D2); V14 is the green sweep. No done-record admits a leftover, and the phase dependencies (P3 on P2's series) were produced. What remains is operator pushes and live checks under Ruling D3 (A1-A4), the doc-phase handoffs named in P3/P4/P5's done-records, and advisory entries already in the close-out. I struck S1, which P3's alert text resolved, and noted S4's doc-phase handoff.
